rows.reason: CopyOnWriteList.ConverterImpl.unmarshal adds every item XStream produced to the list without checking it against the declared element type, so an attacker-controlled config.xml can deserialize an arbitrary type into a typed list field and reach the usual XStream gadget surface (CWE-502). SECURITY-3707 adds the elementType check around this add; frozen line 204 is the removed unchecked items.add(item).
